gbp_reviews_visible.text: We recently used AZ New Bath for our remodel and couldn't be happier with the final outcome. If you are looking for a team that takes ownership of their work and delivers high-quality results, look no further. …

We renovated our bathroom with the AZ New Bath.
We replaced our old shower with a new one, upgraded all the fixtures and mirrors,  replaced our old cabinets with the white oak ones and upgraded the vanity top …

Amazing family company.
Wayne is who we got the quote from. He explained everything, showed us our options, and had samples with him in person which was a huge help for picking shower …
